question: Na letišti platí běžné pravidlo 100 mililitrů pro tekutiny v příručním zavazadle. Pravda, nebo nepravda: dvousetmililitrovou lahev, ve které zbývá už jen trocha šamponu, si do kabiny vzít smíte.
source_excerpt: The EU-wide 100 ml rule has not been scrapped. Relief is happening airport by airport as CT scanners are installed.

extra.why_interesting: Most travellers assume the 100 ml limit is about how much liquid you carry, so a nearly empty bigger bottle feels fine. The rule actually measures the container's capacity, which explains the half-empty shampoo bottles left in security bins.
extra.verification_notes: The 100 ml limit applies to container capacity, not contents, and was reimposed EU-wide by Regulation (EU) 2024/2108; only some CT-equipped lanes relax it, which the question's premise excludes (https://migflug.com/afterburner/?p=27070431).

explanation: Rozhoduje objem, který je na obalu, ne kolik tekutiny v něm zbývá. Proto na kontrole končí i skoro prázdné lahve.

question: Letíte z Prahy do Paříže a v duty free zaplatíte běžnou daň. Když ale letíte z Prahy do Londýna, nakoupíte tam bez daně. Čím to je?
alternative_answers: Velká Británie není v Evropské unii
source_excerpt: duty and tax free sales to UK-bound passengers would be permissible from member states

extra.why_interesting: Players assume 'duty free' means cheap shopping for anyone at an airport. In fact your destination decides it, and a big political event the player knows well quietly changed the shopping rules at Václav Havel Airport. The player can reason it out ('what's different about London?'), so the answer gives an 'of course!' moment.
extra.verification_notes: Post-Brexit, UK-bound flights from EU airports qualify for duty-free sales while intra-EU flights do not; I found no newer development changing this, though my search surfaced no 2026 sources (see https://www.trbusiness.com/regional-news/international/uncertainty-remains-with-the-united-kingdom-finally-set-to-leave-the-eu/182087).

explanation: Nákupy bez daně mezi zeměmi EU skončily už v roce 1999. Británie je od brexitu pro celníky „třetí země“, a tak se na lety do Londýna duty free zase vrátilo.
